_source.name: World Stress Map Database Release 2016
_source.citation: Heidbach, O., Rajabi, M., Reiter, K., Ziegler, M., WSM Team (2016): World Stress Map Database Release 2016. V. 1.1. GFZ Data Services.
_source.product: the World Stress Map interpolated onto a mesh of cells about 300 km across, uniform on the sphere
_source.method: each cell is the distance-weighted circular mean of the records within 450 km, sigma half that; the mean is taken on the doubled angle because SHmax is an axis, and the regime is the class with the most weight behind it rather than an average of category codes
_source.support: `records` counts the measurements in range, `support` weights them by distance and quality in units of C-quality records, and `nearest_km` is how far the closest one is. A cell is drawn INSET in proportion to its support, so a tentative cell leaves a gap round itself and a well-supported one fills its square.
_source.coverage: the WSM is global in extent and not in sampling: 63% of its records lie within 100 km of a plate boundary, and plate interiors — 41% of the surface — have a median 537 km to the nearest measurement. Colour by `records` or `nearest_km` to see it.
